global.title: Meta introduces camera-free AI glasses
global.summary: Meta says the camera-free glasses will be lighter and have up to 12 hours battery life.

global.summaryKo: 메타는 카메라를 뺀 이번 안경이 더 가볍고 배터리가 최대 12시간 지속된다고 밝혔다.
global.summaryEn: Meta introduced camera-free AI glasses that it says are lighter and offer up to 12 hours of battery life.

global.title: Anthropic says its biology lab has already found something big
global.summary: But maybe the biggest reveal is that Anthropic has not let Claude run loose in its biology lab. Humans are still, so far, in the loop.

global.summaryKo: 앤트로픽이 생물학 연구소에서 큰 발견을 했다고 밝혔다. 다만 Claude에게 연구소를 맡기지 않았고, 아직은 사람이 과정에 개입하고 있다.
global.summaryEn: Anthropic says its biology lab has already found something big, but it has not let Claude run loose there; humans are still in the loop.

global.title: Two years of OpenAI Academy
global.summary: Marking two years of OpenAI Academy and bringing AI skills to even more communities.
global.summaryKo: OpenAI가 OpenAI Academy 2주년을 맞아 더 많은 지역사회에 AI 역량 교육을 확대한다.
global.summaryEn: OpenAI marks two years of OpenAI Academy and is bringing AI skills to more communities.
